partition: Only these explicit training and review recording IDs are ever opened. All 10 reserve IDs and publisher test/validation stay unopened. All selected sessions share publisher's training status. 29 training/11 assessment recordings within 17/6 R prefix groups; actual eligible counts follow the prespecified exclusions. No generalization to people.
source: Coarse Action sentence plus source event ID/start/end/duration and optional verb/noun (diagnostic only). Right_sync rows contain metric 3D positions with active + joint valid and tracked flags. Require all contributing coordinates finite. Use recorded sync time in seconds; accept non-decreasing time, choosing the first row at a repeated time. Strictly increasing after de-duplication. Filter samples to the event [start,end), so a competing event cannot share a frame, and require source duration >0 and >=2 distinct sync times within the event. Train and score complete eligible galleries. Invalid/blank annotations counted separately.
phase: 24 evenly spaced bin midpoints. Use nearest measured row inside the interval, resolving a temporal tie toward earlier time; distance <=0.10 s. No interpolation. Compute the fifteen Euclidean pair distances among wrist, thumb/index/middle/ring/little fingertips (OpenXR indices 1,5,10,15,20,25, combinations in this order) plus the distance of the wrist to its first valid sampled wrist location. All 16 channels are metres. No global coordinates, subject size normalization, clock, mask, ordinal or duration in the learned motion encoder. Genuine gaps stay NaN. Keep a segment only when >=12 of 24 bins have >=8 of the 16 finite channels and those bins collectively contain >=2 different measured frame times. Keep the fixed thresholds and record counts even if cohort is too small. Expert source for joint order is the HoloLensCapture exporter README. Apparent wrist translation includes measurement error and body/whole-hand movement.
duplicate_order: Validate text and interval, group equal start/end and canonical tokenized captions. Retain all unique human wordings on exact intervals; diagnostic source verb/noun is present only if all retained captions for the interval share the same nonempty pair. Apply motion eligibility before removing partially overlapping valid intervals. Keep earliest onset then earliest offset. Require gallery >=2. No adaptive substitutions. Phase validity masks and missing transitions are part of the nuisance analysis.
wrong_ridge: Apply the same per-recording cyclic rearrangement as wrong-pair attention, assigning each complete caption group to a different segment's geometric descriptors. Reuse exact ridge design/weights of observations/penalty and candidate vectors.
length_text: Use only log1p(untruncated source token count), standardized on training sentences, plus intercept with identical regression target, sample weights, ridge penalty and geometry scoring. Compare attention and genuine ridge to both wrong pairing controls and this baseline.
precision: Rank raw unrounded score values within each recording and report candidate counts plus trivially saturated R@5 galleries. Treat all family-bootstrap comparisons and positive results as exploratory in this bounded six-group study. For the different-sentence same-action diagnostic, exclude candidate segments sharing any complete normalized query wording with this query, except its own target, retaining queries with at least one remaining competitor.
fit_seal: Verify all selected training-source files present, source split hash, explicit partitions, code/policy hashes, train feature/exclusion ledger, normalization, metadata and weights. Freeze before reading real review data. A source-wide acquisition failure remains explicit with no silent reduction.
display: Predeclare the fitted ridge as default and attention as optional, with explicit identification and frozen weights for both. The redistributable example gallery uses the lexicographically first eligible training recording, up to every eligible segment; embeddings and labels represent real derived training data, with accompanying CDLA text and source attribution. This demonstration gallery gives no independent performance estimate.
